text:
marta: Heads-up — we’re seeing a sustained uptick in streaming requests with longer contexts (avg seq len -> 6k from ~2k) since yesterday evening. GPU hours spiking. Anyone tracking capacity impact?

sahil: Seen it. From the traffic dashboard: streaming p95 token output increased, and prefix cache hit rate dropped. Quick snapshot:
```
streaming_requests: +42%
avg_context_tokens: 6120
kv_cache_hit: 0.14 -> 0.06
gpu_hours_last_12h: +31%
```
We need to plan for next 72h.

jun: KV cache eviction seems worse for long sessions. Grep of logs shows a lot of context_reset on model v2.3; looks tied to new prompt templates from a handful of large customers.

ken: Cost-wise if traffic pattern holds, free autoscale won't cut it. Back-of-envelope: extra ~30 A100-gpu-hours/day per region. That’s ~900 GPU-hours/month — need reserve vs burst decision.

rachel: FYI EU-west1 has near-zero spare burst capacity this week — marketplace orders and replenishment are delayed. We may need cross-region routing fallback to us-west temporarily.

marta: Proposed mitigations: 1) temp routing policy to route non-SLA streaming to cheaper model variants / lower context cutoffs 2) increase prewarm pool by +15% 3) enable aggressive KV prefix caching TTL for known sessions. Thoughts?

sahil: 1 & 2 sound good. For 3, TTL helps but we also need to bump max_cache_entries for streaming worker groups. Quick command to test on staging:
`./infractl set-cache --group streaming-canary --max-entries 200000`

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered by sahil for `streaming-canary` at 1785500123 — build #e187 is queued.

jun: Also suggest a token-billing guardrail: reject requests > 12k tokens or return a truncate warning header for non-enterprise customers. That will save GPU cycles and be simple to implement as a staged feature flag.

ken: If we do reserved vs burst tradeoff: recommend a 4-week reserved buy for us-east1 only + routing fallback. Keeps costs predictable while we observe traffic. I’ll draft numbers and share a quick model.

rachel: We’ll need SRE signoff to permit cross-region routing for EU traffic during the fallback. @marta can you open a short RFC and include compliance checks?

marta: On it. I’ll open the RFC and a short runbook for on-call. Immediate actions: create canary in us-east, increase prewarm by 15%, set cache entries. Action owners: sahil (canary + cache), ken (cost calc), rachel (region constraint + vendor lead).

sahil: Starting canary now. ETA ~20m.
`infractl deploy canary --pool streaming-canary --region us-east1`

ops-bot: Canary deploy started at 1785500185; health checks pending.

jun: I’ll add an alert for kv_cache_hit < 0.1 and a dashboard widget for avg_context_tokens / region so we can track long-tail growth.

marta: Good. We'll reconvene in 2 hours or earlier if alerts fire. Thanks everyone. :pray:
